entries.jp:
――これは
龍馬高杉桂の三人が
新選組と敵対していた
頃の話
entries.en:
--This is a story
from the days
when Ryoma,
Takasugi and
Katsura were
still at odds with
the Shinsengumi.

entries.jp: ねえねえ\nあの隊列を見て！\n新選組の皆様よ
entries.en:
Hey, hey, look at
that procession!
It's the
gentlemen of the
Shinsengumi!

entries.jp: ああ　本当だわっ\n町の見回りをされてるのね
entries.en:
Oh, it really
is! They must
be patrolling
the town.

entries.jp: 隊の先頭にいるのは\n土方様と総司様だわ\nああ　今日も麗しいっ
entries.en:
At the head of
the unit are
Hijikata-sama
and Soji-sama!
Ah, so dazzling
again today!

entries.jp: 土方様　総司様\nお慕いしております～～！
entries.en: Hijikata-sama!\nSoji-sama! We\nadore youuuu!

entries.jp: 新選組万歳\n愛獲最高です～～～
entries.en:
Long live the
Shinsengumi!
Idols are the
beeeest!

entries.jp: 隊列を組んで歩く\n新選組に大勢の女性が\n黄色い声を上げる
entries.en:
Crowds of women
squealed at the
Shinsengumi
marching in
formation.

entries.jp: その声援を受けて沖田は\n爽やかに微笑みながら\n群衆に手を振った
entries.en:
Basking in their
cheers, Okita
smiled brightly
and waved to
the crowd.

entries.jp: みんな　ありがとう～\n大好きだよ～
entries.en: Thank you,\neveryone! I\nlove you aaall!

entries.jp: これからも僕達の事を\n沢山応援してね～
entries.en: Keep cheering\nus on lots and\nlots, okay?

entries.jp: ぎゃあああっ　\n総司様ああああ\n素敵ですうううう
entries.en:
KYAAAH!
Soji-samaaaa!
You're so
dreamyyyy!

entries.jp: 土方様も一言\nお願いします～～\n手も振って～～～
entries.en:
A word from
you too,
Hijikata-sama!
Pleeease! Wave
to us toooo!

entries.jp: あ　あら？　土方様～～？\nどうされたんですか～～？
entries.en:
Oh my?
Hijikata-samaaa?
Is something
wrooong?

entries.jp: あ　ちょっとごめんね～
entries.en: Ah, excuse\nus just a sec!

entries.jp: ほら　土方さん\n煌の前ですよ？
entries.en:
Come on,
Hijikata-san,
the fans are
watching.

entries.jp: ほらほらムッとしないで\nカワイイ犬の写真ですよ
entries.en:
Come on, come
on, don't sulk.
Look, a photo of
a cute puppy.

entries.jp: ……む……\nかわいい……
entries.en: ...Hm... Cute...

entries.jp: いや……\n悪いがそんな気分\nじゃないんだ……
entries.en: No... Sorry,\nbut I'm not in\nthe mood...

entries.jp: もー\nこりゃ相当重症だね
entries.en: Geez. This is\na serious case.

entries.jp: あー　みんな　ごめんね\n土方さん　太陽の下に出ると\n具合が悪くなる体質なんだ
entries.en:
Ah, sorry,
everyone!
Hijikata-san has
this condition
where he gets
sick if he goes
out in the sun.

entries.jp: まあ　そうなんですか
entries.en: Oh my, is that so?

entries.jp: うん　だから町の見回りは\n僕らに任せるように\n言ったんだけど
entries.en:
Yeah, so I told
him to leave
the town patrol
to us, but...

entries.jp: みんなの事が心配だって\n土方さん　聞かなくて
entries.en:
Hijikata-san
wouldn't listen.
He said he was
worried about
all of you.

entries.jp: きゃぁぁっ　土方様\n私達の事を考えて下さって\nいるのですねっ
entries.en:
Kyaaah!
Hijikata-sama,
you're
thinking of us!

entries.jp: 素晴らしいです\n土方様～～
entries.en: How wonderful!\nHijikata-samaaa!

entries.jp: 仏　\n貴方が仏だったのですねっ\n土方様
entries.en:
A Buddha! You
were a living
Buddha all along,
Hijikata-sama!

entries.jp: うん　じゃあそういう事で\n土方さんと僕は失礼するね
entries.en:
Yep, so, on that
note, Hijikata-san
and I will take
our leave.

entries.jp: 君達　後はお願いね
entries.en: You guys, take\nit from here.

entries.jp: はい　お任せください
entries.en: Yes, sir!\nLeave it to us.

entries.jp: 土方さん　行きましょう\nそんな顔で公の場にいると\n煌が減りますから
entries.en:
Let's go,
Hijikata-san.
Standing
around in public
with that face,
we'll lose fans.

entries.jp: ………………\nわかった
土方は沖田の言葉に頷くと\n彼と共に人通りの少ない\n路地裏へ向かった
entries.en:
Hijikata nodded
at Okita's words
and went with
him into a quiet
back alley.

entries.jp: ふぅ……\nここまで来れば\n大丈夫か……
entries.en: Phew... We should\nbe safe out here...

entries.jp: ちょっと土方さん\nいつまでムクれてるんです\nいい加減にして下さいよ
entries.en:
Come on,
Hijikata-san.
How long are
you going to
sulk? Give it a
rest already.

entries.jp: ……俺なりに\n注意を払ってはいる
entries.en: ...I am being\ncareful. In\nmy own way.

entries.jp: だが奴らの事を考えると\nどうしても表情が\n強張ってしまうんだ
entries.en:
But when I think
of them, my
face goes stiff.
Can't help it.

entries.jp: 奴らって　\nトサカくん達の事ですか
entries.en: "Them"? You\nmean Tosaka-kun\nand his pals?

entries.jp: ああ
entries.en: Yeah.

entries.jp: はあ　やっぱりね
entries.en: Huh. I knew it.

entries.jp: 奴らは　俺達の目を盗み\n毎日のように突風雷舞を\nおこなっている
entries.en:
They slip past us
and hold guerrilla
lives practically
every day.

entries.jp: こんな暴挙は許せない\n一刻も早く　俺達の手で\n捕まえなければ
entries.en:
An outrage like
that can't be
tolerated. We
must catch them
ourselves, as
soon as possible.

entries.jp: だがあと一歩のところで\nいつも逃げられてしまう
entries.en:
But every time,
they get away
when we're
one step short.

entries.jp: 俺達は　\nたった三人の男に\n振り回されている
entries.en: We're being\njerked around by\njust three men.

entries.jp: こんな屈辱は初めてだ
entries.en: I've never been\nso humiliated.

entries.jp: 今日こそ奴らを捕まえて\n目玉をくり抜き　口を裂き\nありとあらゆる罰を与え
entries.en:
Today we catch
them. I'll gouge
out their eyes, rip
their mouths
open, inflict
every punishment
there is...

entries.jp: 釜茹でにしてやる……
entries.en: ...and boil\nthem alive in\na cauldron...

entries.jp: あ　それ良いですねー
entries.en: Oh, that\nsounds nice.

entries.jp: でも釜茹でよりも\n油でこんがり揚げる方が\n僕の好みかな
entries.en:
But instead of
boiling them, I'd
rather deep-fry
them nice and
crispy in oil.

entries.jp: 坂本　高杉　桂\n今日がお前達の命日だ
entries.en:
Sakamoto,
Takasugi,
Katsura... Today
is the day you die.

entries.jp: 土方は\n道端の小石を睨み付け\n乱暴に蹴り上げる
entries.en:
Hijikata glared
at a pebble by
the roadside and
kicked it roughly.

entries.jp:
宙に浮いた小石は弧を描き
前方の瓦落多（ガラクタ）
置き場に
コツンと音を立てて当たった
entries.en:
The pebble
sailed in an arc
and struck the
junk pile ahead
with a *clunk*.

entries.jp: ……すると
entries.en: ...And then.

entries.jp: くぅん……
entries.en: *Whimper*...

entries.jp: 瓦落多置き場の中から\nもじゃもじゃ頭の男が\nひょっこりと顔を出した
entries.en:
From inside the
junk pile, a man
with shaggy
hair popped his
head out.

entries.jp: ……あれ
entries.en: ...Huh?

entries.jp: もしかして　\nそこにいるのは\nトサカくん？
entries.en: Wait, is that...\nTosaka-kun\nover there?

entries.jp: くぅ……？
entries.en: *Whine*...?

entries.jp: 土方と沖田は　\n突然現れた男の顔を\nまじまじと凝視した
entries.en:
Hijikata and Okita
stared hard at the
face of the man
who had suddenly
appeared.

entries.jp: ……このニヤけた顔\n間違いなく　坂本だな
entries.en:
...That grinning
face. It's
Sakamoto, no
doubt about it.

entries.jp: ですね　トサカくんです\nけど何でこんな所に\nいるんでしょう？
entries.en:
Yep, it's
Tosaka-kun. But
what's he doing in
a place like this?

entries.jp: それも気になるが\n俺達が近づいても\nなぜ逃げようとしない
entries.en:
That bothers me
too. But why isn't
he running, even
as we get closer?

entries.jp: さあ　わかりません\nトサカくん　どうして？
entries.en: Beats me.\nTosaka-kun,\nwhy's that?

entries.jp: 大人しく答えろ\n坂本
entries.en: Answer me,\nand no tricks,\nSakamoto.

entries.jp: くぅん？
entries.en: *Whimper*?

entries.jp:
眼光鋭く問い詰める
土方を
龍馬はつぶらな瞳で
見つめ返す
entries.en:
Hijikata's glare
bored into him,
and Ryoma
gazed back with
big, round,
innocent eyes.

entries.jp: そして……
entries.en: And then...

entries.jp: きゃわんっ
entries.en: Yip!

entries.jp: 土方に\n勢いよく抱きついた
entries.en: He threw his\narms around\nHijikata.

entries.jp: んな\nさささささ坂本っ　\nどういうつもりだ！
entries.en:
Wha--
S-s-s-s-Sakamoto!
What do you
think you're
doing!?

entries.jp: きゃわん　きゃわんっ\nわわん　わわんっ
entries.en: Yip, yip! Arf, arf!

entries.jp: おい　こらっ\n顔を近づけるな\n頬ずりをするなっ！
entries.en:
Hey! Cut it out!
Get your face
away! Stop
nuzzling me!

entries.jp: ん～～　トサカくんの\n様子が明らかに変だ\nまるで犬みたい
entries.en:
Hmmm,
Tosaka-kun's
clearly acting
weird. He's
just like a dog.

entries.jp: くっ……確かに
entries.en: Ngh... True.

entries.jp: この懐きようは　\n主人に尻尾を振る犬\nそっくりだな……
entries.en:
The way he's
clinging to me...
He's exactly like a
dog wagging its
tail at its master...

entries.jp: そうですねー\nどうしてトサカくんは\n犬の真似をしてるんだろう
entries.en:
Yeah. I wonder
why Tosaka-kun's
pretending to be
a dog.

entries.jp: まさか　何か企んでる？\n僕らを罠に掛けようと\nしてるとか？
entries.en:
Don't tell me he's
up to something?
Trying to lure us
into a trap?

entries.jp: 土方さんが動物好きだと\n見抜いて　犬の真似を\nしてるなら侮れないなぁ
entries.en:
If he saw through
to Hijikata-san's
love of animals
and is playing a
dog for that, he's
not to be
underestimated.

entries.jp: でも　細かい事はいっか！\n敵に抵抗される前に\nやっちゃえば良いだけだし
entries.en:
But eh, never
mind the details!
We just have to
finish him off
before the enemy
fights back.

entries.jp: ねえねえ　土方さん\n取り乱すのは\nそこら辺にして
entries.en: Hey, Hijikata-san,\nthat's enough\nlosing your cool.

entries.jp: トサカくんの目玉を\nさっさと\nくり抜いちゃいましょうよ
entries.en:
Let's hurry up
and gouge out
Tosaka-kun's
eyes.

entries.jp: あ……ああ　そうだな\n様子がおかしくても\n敵は敵だ
entries.en: R-right... Weird\nor not, an enemy\nis an enemy.

entries.jp: 今ここで　\n俺が罰を与えてやる
entries.en: I'll punish you\nright here,\nright now.

entries.jp: 土方は気を取り直すと\n龍馬を再び睨みつけた
entries.en:
Hijikata pulled
himself together
and glared at
Ryoma once more.

entries.jp: ……くぅぅん？
entries.en: ...*Whiiimper*?

entries.jp: ぐっ……\nそんなつぶらな瞳で\n俺を見るなっ
entries.en: Ngh... Don't look\nat me with those\nbig round eyes!

entries.jp: 土方はうろたえながら\n龍馬の目元を拭った
entries.en:
Flustered,
Hijikata
wiped around
Ryoma's eyes.

entries.jp: ちょっと土方さん\n何　してるんです
entries.en: Um, Hijikata-san,\nwhat are you\ndoing?

entries.jp: はっ\nこ　これは　つい\n坂本が本物の犬に見えて
entries.en:
Ah! Th-this is... I
just... Sakamoto
looked like a
real dog...

entries.jp: 睫毛についていた埃を\n取ってしまった……
entries.en:
...and I ended
up picking the
dust off his
eyelashes...

entries.jp: ふーん？\nなら先に　トサカくんの\n口を裂いちゃいましょうか
entries.en:
Hmm? Then shall
we rip
Tosaka-kun's
mouth open first?

entries.jp: あ　ああ　そうだな\n坂本　じっとしてろ
entries.en: R-right.\nSakamoto,\nhold still.

entries.jp: 今度こそ　\nお前に罰を与えてやる！
entries.en: This time, you're\ngetting your\npunishment!

entries.jp: ……きゅぅぅん？
entries.en: ...*Whiiine*?

entries.jp: ぐっ……ぐぅぅぅっ\n切なそうに鼻を鳴らすなっ
entries.en:
Ngh... Nggghh...
Don't whine
through your
nose so pitifully!

entries.jp: 土方は龍馬の口元に\n布を強く押しあてた
entries.en: Hijikata pressed\na cloth firmly to\nRyoma's mouth.

entries.jp: って　土方さん\n今度はトサカくんの口元を\n拭ってあげてるし
entries.en:
Uh, Hijikata-san,
now you're wiping
Tosaka-kun's
mouth for him.

entries.jp: し　仕方ないだろう\n坂本の口元に
entries.en:
I-it can't be
helped. Sakamoto
had something
on his mouth...

entries.jp: 食いかすのような物が\nついていたからな……
entries.en: ...that looked like\nbits of food...

entries.jp: あーもう　じれったい
entries.en: Ugh, this is so\nfrustrating.

entries.jp: 土方さん　屯所に戻って\nトサカくんを釜茹でに\nしましょうよ
entries.en:
Hijikata-san,
let's take
Tosaka-kun back
to headquarters
and boil him in
a cauldron.

entries.jp: そ　そうだな\n瓦落多置き場に居たから\n体が汚れてるだろうし
entries.en: R-right. He was in\na junk pile, so he\nmust be filthy...

entries.jp: 釜茹でにして\n綺麗にしてやろう
entries.en:
We'll boil him
in a cauldron
and get him
nice and clean.

entries.jp: 綺麗にって……
entries.en: Nice and clean...?

entries.jp: まさかトサカくんを\n適温のお湯に入れてあげる\nつもりですか
entries.en:
Don't tell me
you're planning to
give Tosaka-kun a
nice bath at just
the right
temperature?

entries.jp: い　いや　俺は別に
entries.en: N-no, I'm not...

entries.jp: ふーーん？
entries.en: Hmmmm?

entries.jp: きゅぅぅん？
entries.en: *Whiiine*?

entries.jp: 龍馬に抱きつかれたまま\n土方はだらだらと\n冷や汗を流す
entries.en:
With Ryoma still
clinging to him,
Hijikata broke
into a cold sweat.

entries.jp: その時　二つの人影が\n龍馬を土方から\n引きはがした
entries.en:
Just then,
two figures
pried Ryoma
off Hijikata.

entries.jp: このバカ野郎\n急に屋敷を飛び出して！\nこんな所にいたのかよっ
entries.en:
You idiot,
running out of
the mansion all
of a sudden! So
this is where
you were!

entries.jp: きゅぅん？
entries.en: *Whine*?

entries.jp: はぁ\n催眠術が　まだ\n解けてないのですね
entries.en: Sigh... So the\nhypnosis still\nhasn't worn off.

entries.jp: 催眠術だと？
entries.en: Hypnosis?

entries.jp: なになに　どういう事なの
entries.en: What's this,\nwhat's this?\nWhat's going on?

entries.jp: 土方と沖田じゃねぇか
entries.en: Well, if it\nisn't Hijikata\nand Okita.

entries.jp: おやおや\n龍馬くん捜しに必死で\n気づきませんでした
entries.en:
Oh my. We were
so busy
searching for
Ryoma-kun, we
didn't notice you.

entries.jp: おい　お前ら\n坂本は一体どうしたんだ\n明らかに様子が変だぞ
entries.en:
Hey, you two.
What on earth
happened to
Sakamoto?
He's clearly
not himself.

entries.jp: あー実はですね……\nその……
entries.en: Ah, well, you\nsee... Um...

entries.jp: 龍馬くんにお願いされて\n伴天連の魔術の本に\n書いてある術を
entries.en:
Ryoma-kun asked
me to try out a
technique written
in a book of
Western sorcery...

entries.jp: 試してみたんですよ
entries.en: ...so I gave it a go.

entries.jp: 魔術と言っても\n六文銭に紐をつけて\n暗示をかけるという
entries.en:
It's called sorcery,
but you just tie a
string to a coin
and plant a
suggestion...

entries.jp: まあ……いわゆる\n催眠術ですけど
entries.en: In other words,\nit's what you'd\ncall hypnosis.

entries.jp: 単純な龍馬くんは\nそれにかかっちゃって
entries.en:
And
simple-minded
Ryoma-kun
fell right
under its spell.

entries.jp: 御覧の通り　自分を\n犬だと思いこんで\nしまったようで……
entries.en:
As you can see,
he seems to have
convinced himself
he's a dog...

entries.jp: へぇー　なるほど
entries.en: Huh, I see.

entries.jp: はぁぁ……通りで\n坂本が犬に見えたわけだ
entries.en:
Ahh... So that's
why Sakamoto
looked like a
dog to me.

entries.jp: くぅん？
entries.en: *Whimper*?

entries.jp: あはは　その様子だと\n君達も龍馬くんに\n振り回されたようですね
entries.en:
Ahaha, judging
by the look of
you, Ryoma-kun
has been running
you ragged too.

entries.jp: 桂さん　お喋りはやめて\nこのバカを連れて\nとっとと逃げるぞ
entries.en:
Katsura-san, quit
chatting. We're
grabbing this
idiot and getting
out of here.

entries.jp: ええ　わかりました\n龍馬くん　帰ったら\n術を解きましょうね
entries.en:
Yes, all right.
Ryoma-kun, let's
undo the spell
once we're home.

entries.jp: では新選組の皆さん\n失礼します
entries.en:
Well then,
gentlemen of the
Shinsengumi,
good day.

entries.jp: 土方達が脱力している隙に\n高杉と桂は龍馬を連れて\n一目散に逃げ出した
entries.en:
While Hijikata
and Okita stood
there deflated,
Takasugi and
Katsura took
Ryoma and fled
at full speed.

entries.jp: あーあ\nまた逃がしちゃいましたね\n土方さん　今の気持ちは？
entries.en:
Aww, they got
away again,
Hijikata-san.
How do you
feel right now?

entries.jp: くっ……今度こそ……\n今度こそ目玉をくり抜き\n口を引き裂いて　そして
entries.en:
Ngh... Next
time... Next time
I'll gouge out
their eyes, rip
their mouths
open, and then...

entries.jp: 釜茹でにしてやる……っ
entries.en: ...boil them alive\nin a cauldron...!

entries.jp: 土方が龍馬たち捕縛への\n決意を新たにしていた頃
entries.en:
While Hijikata
was renewing
his resolve to
capture Ryoma
and the others...

entries.jp: 術から解けた龍馬は\nにこやかに笑っていた
entries.en: ...Ryoma, freed\nfrom the spell,\nwas all smiles.

entries.jp: いやー　ついさっきまで\nすごく楽しい夢を\n見てたぜよー！
entries.en:
Man, I was havin'
the most fun
dream till just a
minute ago!

entries.jp: わしは　夢の中で\nヒジゾーさんに\n遊んでもらったんじゃ
entries.en: In my dream,\nHijizo-san was\nplayin' with me.

entries.jp: ヒジゾーさんは　わしの\n目や口元を拭いてくれて\n撫でてくれて
entries.en:
Hijizo-san wiped
my eyes and my
mouth, and gave
me pats...

entries.jp: とにかく　優しかったぜよ\nわし　ヒジゾーさんの事\n好きじゃー
entries.en: He was real\ngentle, I tell ya!\nI like Hijizo-san!

entries.jp: この　バカ\nオレ様達の苦労も知らずに\nんなこと言うんじゃねぇ！
entries.en:
You idiot! Don't
say stuff like that
when you've got
no clue what you
put us through!

entries.jp: あははは　\n笑うしかないですね
entries.en: Ahahaha... All we\ncan do is laugh.

entries.jp: 三人の賑やかな声が\n京の青空に響く
entries.en:
The three men's
lively voices rang
out under the
blue sky of Kyoto.

entries.jp: こうして催眠術による\n騒動は平和に幕を\n閉じたのだった
entries.en:
And so the
hypnosis
uproar came to
a peaceful end.
